roster.note: the first spacecraft to land successfully on Mars and operate — an orbiter to map from above and a lander to work on the surface

roster.name: Viking 1 lands
roster.note: on 20 July 1976 the Viking 1 lander touched down in Chryse Planitia and returned the first pictures ever taken from the surface of Mars

roster.name: Viking 2
roster.note: a second orbiter-and-lander pair, set down thousands of kilometres away in Utopia Planitia six weeks later

roster.name: The biology experiments
roster.note: each lander ran experiments designed to detect life in the Martian soil; the results were ambiguous, and remain argued over to this day
